name: RiveStream
description: RiveStream (rivestream.ru) - "Your Personal Streaming Oasis". TMDB-powered catalog of movies & TV, streamed from rivestream's own Rive server backends (Citadel, Prvibd, River, Kutti, Gbru, HindiSk) with multi-language and Hindi-dubbed tracks, plus fallback servers. Verified live.
